balanceStatus.description: Balance state after applying session costs.

sessionStatus.description: Current lifecycle status of the session.

balanceAmountMinor.description: Type "Long". This field is not relevant for External Clearing (only used when using Plugsurfing's Payment Service Provider). Represents the remaining amount to be paid, expressed as a negative number. A value of 0 indicates the balance is fully paid. -2160 means there is an outstanding amount of 21.60 in the currency of the session.

chargingKeyType.description: Only available after a session has successfully started. Possible values are "tag", "card", "virtual" or "plug_and_charge".

connectorId.description: Only available after a session has successfully started.

duration.description: The value is in ISO 8601 duration format

paymentMethod.description: Returns the `paymentMethod` of the transaction with the earliest timestamp. This field is `DEPRECATED` and will be removed in future versions. Use `session.transactions[].paymentMethod` instead. Migration note: `WRITE_OFF` was renamed to `NONE`, where `session.transactions[].paymentOutcome=WRITE_OFF` is the replacement

receiptAvailable.description: Indicates whether a receipt can be downloaded.

sessionId.description: Unique identifier of the charging session.

startTime.description: UTC timestamp when the session started.

transactions.description: Transactions linked to this charging session.

SessionAmount.description: Monetary amount with currency and VAT breakdown.

SessionBalanceStatus.description: Note: this field is not relevant when using External Clearing.

chargingStationName.description: Display name of the charging station.

city.description: City where the charger is located.

connectorLabel.description: Connector label reported by the charge point operator.

evseId.description: EVSE identifier for the charging point.

SessionCharger.description: Location and connector information for the charger used in a session.

value.description: Measured energy value for the session.

SessionEnergy.description: Energy measurement data for a charging session.

SessionStatus.description: IMPORTANT - when handling this enum other unknown values should be handled.

Time.description: Timestamp in ISO 8601 UTC format with up to nanosecond precision.

Transaction.description: Represents a transaction with payment details and time.

paymentMethod.description: The payment method used for the transaction. Can be `NONE` for outcome `WRITE_OFF`

paymentOutcome.description: The outcome of the payment process.
